title: Locally finite Tor dimension
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Say that $E$ locally has finite Tor dimension if every point $x\in X$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and integers $a\le b$ such that $H^i(E|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}\mathcal G)=0$ for every $\mathcal O_U$-module $\mathcal G$ and every $i\notin[a,b]$. Here $U$ is the open subscheme, $E|_U=Lj^*E$ is the derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] along the inclusion $j:U\to X$, and $H^i(E|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}\mathcal G)=0$ is the derived tensor cohomology vanishing predicate on $U$ [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes].
